# 0.7.0 release plan: Paper Draft Contributions

Status: planning scaffold for [Agents #80](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research-agents/issues/80) in the coordinated [Study to Evidence to Paper Draft release](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research/issues/41). This file does not declare 0.7.0 released.

## Outcome

Supported agents, workflows, models, and tools can describe their reportable configuration and point to observed execution evidence without depending on Experiments.

## Scope

- Add an explicit public adapter, provisionally `collect_agent_paper_contributions(...)`.
- Contribute factual Methods material, reporting requirements, curated citations, configuration snapshots, and evidence references.
- Preserve the distinction between configured availability and observed execution or tool invocation.
- Record stable component identifiers plus package/version provenance.
- Redact credentials, tokens, and other secrets from configuration and provenance.
- Begin with explicit adapters for supported constructs.

## Acceptance

- Representative agent and workflow patterns emit deterministic contributions.
- A configured-but-unused tool cannot appear as an observed tool invocation.
- Observed tool/model/workflow activity links to persisted run evidence.
- Missing evidence becomes a `partial` or `todo` contribution.
- Existing APIs remain compatible.

## Non-goals

No arbitrary workflow introspection, paper assembly, automatic interpretation, or storage/tracking platform.
